verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting states that Blackwater won more than 2 billion dollars in federal contracts after its 1997 founding and before its 2010 sale. Government hearings independently document more than 1 billion dollars through 2006, consistent with the later cumulative figure.

records.text: Owens corrected herself to say Blackwater personnel killed 14 Iraqi civilians and injured 20 others while escorting a U.S. embassy convoy, and said four men were convicted, one of murder and three of manslaughter.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So a terrible massacre took place in Iraq, which landed four of their men in prison. They killed 17 Iraqi civilians and injured 14, pardon, 14 Iraqi civilians and injured 20 others while escorting a U.S. embassy convoy. Again, we just asked them to escort us. ... Like I said, four men were convicted, one of murder, three others of manslaughter charges. But no worries, because when Trump (Donald Trump) got into office the first time around, he pardoned all of them. Very controversial, but all of them got pardoned, so they're free.

verification.notes: Justice Department records confirm 14 unarmed civilians killed and 20 wounded in the Nisur Square shooting, with one contractor convicted of first-degree murder and three convicted on voluntary manslaughter counts.
